Jisu thakddunsi pulo, “Philip,Jesus said to him, “Have Ine lapu-an arni keding nangtum been with you all this time,along nangkedodun anta nang- Philip, and you still do not knowtum nephan nechininelangma? me? Whoever has seen me hasNephan nekethek-long abang ke seen the Father. How can youPo aphanta thek-long-lo. Tangte say, ‘Show us the Father’?nang kopisi, ‘Netum aphan Ponepaklangtha,’ pu kepulangma?
